claims: Brad Brownell is the head men's basketball coach at Clemson University.
Brad Brownell has held the position of head men's basketball coach at Clemson University since the 2010-11 season.
As of March 2026, Brad Brownell has led the Clemson men's basketball team to a 24-11 record in the 2025-26 season.
Brad Brownell is the second all-time winningest coach in Clemson men's basketball history.
Brad Brownell has over 300 wins in Clemson men's basketball history.
Brownell was named to the 2026 Naismith Men's College Coach of the Year Watch List, notes Instagram.
Brownell led Clemson to the NCAA Tournament, notes Instagram.
Before coming to Clemson, Brad Brownell held head coaching positions at Wright State.
Before coming to Clemson, Brad Brownell held head coaching positions at UNC Wilmington.
As of March 2026, top assistant Billy Donlon left Brad Brownell's staff to become the head coach at Eastern Michigan, notes The State.
Billy Donlon remained through the tournament, notes The State.
The current head coach for the Clemson women's basketball team is Shawn Poppie, notes WLTX.
